This looks like a white plate of roughly 24 cm. On it is a slice of avocado toast or flatbread topped with arugula, mushroom or radish slices, and possibly bacon. Next to it is a small round fritter or hash brown topped with red cabbage slaw.

The toast is about 14 cm long and 8 cm wide, so I estimate about 90 g for the bread plus about 50 g for the avocado spread and toppings, roughly 140 g in all. At about 2.2 kcal/g for the bread with avocado, that comes to roughly 280 kcal.

The fritter with slaw is about 7 cm across and weighs about 50 g. At about 2 kcal/g, that is roughly 100 kcal.

Together that gives about 190 g of food and about 380 kcal.
